skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will be able to analyze and evaluate science and technology policies in practical scenarios, understand the interplay between science, technology, and socio-economic development, and assess the impact of policies at both micro and macro levels.
Students will develop skills to evaluate science and technology policies in organizational contexts, apply analytical tools, and assess the effectiveness of R&D policies.
Students will learn to formulate, implement, and evaluate R&D policies, and practice presentation, teamwork, and group management skills.
Students will be able to independently conduct operational tasks related to policy analysis and R&D, continuously improve their skills, and demonstrate creativity and adaptability.
Students will develop critical thinking skills to identify common errors in policy analysis and apply analytical processes to improve policy analysis.
Students will understand the principles and tools of state management in science and technology, and evaluate the factors influencing science and technology policies.
Students will gain knowledge in science and technology, and understand the interrelationships between science, technology, and socio-economic development.
Students will demonstrate professional ethics and social responsibility in their work.
Students will practice teamwork and group management skills.
Students will develop skills to present their findings effectively.
